explanation: A real 2021 XRBS paper exists, but it is Shareef et al. in Nature Biotechnology, not Hui T et al. in Nature Communications. The claimed Nat Commun 12:5265 citation points to a different paper, so this appears to be a mashed-up citation rather than a fully real one.
mismatches: authors: claimed Hui T et al., actual Shareef S.J., Bevill S.M., Raman A.T. et al.
title: claimed Extended representation bisulfite sequencing (XRBS), actual Extended-representation bisulfite sequencing of gene regulatory elements in multiplexed samples and single cells
venue: claimed Nat Commun, actual Nat Biotechnol
Nat Commun 12:5265: actual paper is Regulation of functional groups on graphene quantum dots directs selective CO2 to CH4 conversion, DOI 10.1038/s41467-021-25640-1
search_attempts: web searched: "Extended representation bisulfite sequencing" XRBS Hui Nat Commun 2021 12 5265
